notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

We're happy to announce that Winds of Change will be leaving Early Access on August 21st, at 9AM PT. This is over a month earlier than our planned launch of September 24th, 2019.

Thanks for the support from everybody in Early Access. We couldn't have done it without you. Let's hope things go well when we open the floodgates!

Final Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8RIFbeN7vk8

Gameplay Overview Trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-0L7lS0wOPM

Enjoyed the game? Join the community!

Telegram: http://t.me/windsofchangegame

Thanks!

Tall Tail Studios

 - Exploration Text has been added to this area.
  - One Party Banter scene has been added to this area.

- A new Achievement has been added.
  - Fate of Mazeo

Thanks! As usual, feel free to give feedback!

Developers Note: The achievement "Share The Love" has been removed from the game. After careful deliberation, we have decided that this is the best choice. Due to the way the cast of characters and romance options are presented, it would be impossible for heterosexual males to get this achievement without initiating a romantic subplot that goes against their sexual orientation, which we feel to be unfair. If this ever changes with the addition of content in the future, the achievement may be reintroduced.

Klace
Creative Director
Tall Tail Studios

notes.title: Patch #1 Released
notes.notes:
Hello!

This is a patch to address some of the things brought up by players.
This patch contains no new story content and no new voiceover content.
Patch notes will always say what content is included.
This is so people who want to avoid unvoiced content will be kept in the loop.

Auto-forward will no longer skip over images of text (help screens and books).
Added replay button to quick menu for retriggering voiced lines.
Added explicit save/load button to save/load screen.
Removed help text relating to rollback.
Quick menu is now hidden during the intro.
Fixed an issue where you could get double credit for certain books.
Adjusted the size of some point and click areas.
Typos and inconsistencies have been fixed.

Thanks very much!

Klace & Cyanic
